'''Puncharoo''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Joeyo]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Kangachamp]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Gifted with incredible talent yet painfully shy, Puncharoo was eventually spotted by [[Pyroprawn]] and taken in for training. Unfortunately, Coach [[Capobeetle]]'s sessions tend to end early, as regular punch bags don't stand a chance against that killer strength."

Puncharoo is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A kangaroo that wears red boxing gloves and has an angry facial expression. It's orange-brown with a cream-white underside, and the tips of its ears and tail are dark brown. It also has blue eyes and a large, dark nose.

Puncharoo's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its red boxing gloves to bright blue.

== Evolution Trial ==
Puncharoo's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Kangachamp]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Puncharoo to increase stats 3 times.
* In [[Island Gold Rush]] use 5,000 energy drinks.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'[[Joeyo]] was still standing at the end, proving that the belt was well-deserved.' - Kangachamp's Memoir"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Now in a rebellious phase, Puncharoo constantly picks fights with Zobos. Practices day and night and challenges anyone in sight."
